question: Which Indian freedom fighter is also known as Bismarck of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**
 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, born on **October 31, 1875**, was a key leader in the Indian National Congress during the Indian independence movement.
 
• After India gained independence, Patel was appointed as the **first Deputy Prime Minister** and **Minister of Home Affairs**.
